hooks.text: 战场本身是一张巨型技能树，必须沿附近节点投资并规划无法全占的路线
hooks.excerpt: Defeat enemies, collect resources, and invest them in the nearby nodes. But be careful where you go next, because you cannot conquer the entire SKIGILL at once. Knowledge of its layout will be crucial to your efficiency in battle and survival!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 英雄从不同武器、特长和技能树位置起步，还能跨区混合其他角色路线
hooks.excerpt: Each starts with their own weapon, perk, and position on the Skigill. Thus, each of them have unique gameplay and strategies available, but it is possible to hybridize them by reaching the other character's zone on the SKIGILL .
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 局外第二枚魔印永久提升属性并解锁武器和角色，高难度再反哺更多资源
hooks.excerpt: It contains permanent statistics increases, new and specific unlockable weapons, and more characters to play! As you progress in the meta-sigil and learn new strategies, you can try harder difficulties, which in turn reward you with more resources to build new strategies with!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
